study type: Retrospective review of prospectively collected data
exposure: Late presenting DDH (diagnosed after 3 months old)
Early presenting DDH (diagnosed before 3 months old)
outcome: Risk factors for late-presenting developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH)
cohort: 392 patients with dislocated hips from a multicenter database, with 259 diagnosed before 3 months old and 133 diagnosed between 3 and 18 months old
finding: Late-presenting developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) was associated with cephalic presentation at birth and swaddling history, while traditional risk factors like breech birth were less common in this group.
mod_finding: Birth presentation (vaginal/cesarean) was not significantly different between early and late-presenting DDH.
birth_weight: Included in the analysis, but no significant difference found between groups.
